name: fast-seo-fix
description: SEO and AI search visibility insights: check any public page's SEO metadata, and read your Fast SEO Fix website data, AI visibility results, keyword research, content calendars, and Google Search Console performance.

interface.longDescription: Fast SEO Fix helps you understand how your website performs in search and in AI assistants. Without an account, check any public page's title, meta description, H1 headings, canonical URL, and noindex directives. Connect your Fast SEO Fix account to review your websites' SEO scores, AI visibility results, keyword research, content calendars, and Google Search Console clicks, impressions, and rankings for websites where you have connected it. The plugin is read-only: it cannot publish or generate content.
